Description:
As a TA applicant
I want to register an account with basic information 
so that I can create and access my applicant profile.
Acceptance Criteria:
1. Required fields enforced
2. Email format valid & unique 
3. Password meets policy 
4. On success, account created and user can proceed to login (or is logged in).
Notes: Supporting story to enable applicant profile creation in TA recruitment system.

Description:
As a TA applicant
I want to log in securely 
so that I can access my profile, CV upload, and job applications.
Acceptance Criteria:
1. Correct credentials authenticate and redirect to applicant area
2. Incorrect credentials show clear error
3. Session established for subsequent requests.

Description:
As a TA applicant
I want to log out 
so that my account remains secure on shared devices.
Acceptance Criteria:
1. Logout ends session/token
2. Redirect to login/landing
3. Back button does not restore authenticated access.

Description:
As a TA applicant
I want only logged-in users to access profile and application features 
so that my personal data is protected.
Acceptance Criteria:
1. Unauthenticated access to protected pages redirects to login
2. After login, return to intended page 
3. Auth checks apply to all protected endpoints.

Description:
As a TA applicant
I want to request a password reset 
so that I can regain access if I forget my password.
Acceptance Criteria:
1. Request via registered email
2. Response does not reveal whether account exists
3. Reset token/link generated and expires.

Description:
As a TA applicant
I want to set a new password using a reset link 
so that I can log in again.
Acceptance Criteria:
1. Valid token allows setting new password
2. Password meets policy
3. Token single-use
4. User can log in with new password.

Description:
As a TA applicant
I want to create my applicant profile
So that I can provide my personal  information and experience for TA recruitment.
Acceptance Criteria:
1. User can register with name, email and student ID
2. User can imput skills and academic background
3. Profile information is stroed successfully in the system

Description:
As a TA applicant
I want to edit my profile information
So that I can keep my information up to date.
Acceptance Criteria:
1. User can modify personal information
2. Updated information can be saved 
3. Changes are reflected when profile is viewed again

Description:
As a TA applicant
I want to view my profile
so that I can check that my information is correct.
Acceptance Criteria:
1. TA sees all profile fields
2. Information matches saved data
3. MO can also view profile

Description:
As a TA applicant
I want to delete my profile
So that I can remove my data from the system if needed.
Acceptance Criteria:
1. User can delete profile
2. System asks for confirmation
3. Deleted profile no longer visible to MO

Description:
As a TA applicant
I want to upload my CV
So that Module Organisers can review my qualifications when selecting applicants.
Acceptance Criteria:
1. User can upload a CV file
2. System stores the CV file path or file name
3. Uploaded CV can be viewed later

Description:
As a TA applicant
I want to replace my CV
So that I can provide the most up-to-date version of my qualifications and experience.
Acceptance Criteria:
1. User can upload a new CV file to replace the existing one.
2. The system removes or archives the previous CV.
3. The system stores the new CV successfully.
4. Uploaded CV can be viewed later

Description:
As a TA applicant
I want to view my uploaded CV
So that I can check that the correct CV has been uploaded.
Acceptance Criteria:
1. TA can see a list of uploaded CVs
2. TA can open a CV file
3. MO can also view CV
4. Error message appears if loading fails

Description:
As a TA applicant
I want to delete my CV
So that I can remove outdated or incorrect files.
Acceptance Criteria:
1. User can delete a CV file
2. System asks for confirmation
3. Deleted CV no longer visible to MO

Description:
As a TA applicant
I want to browse available TA jobs
So that I can find suitable opportunities.
Acceptance Criteria:
1. Job list is displayed
2. Each job shows module name and requirements
3. Users can view job details

Description:
As a TA applicant
I want to search and filter available TA jobs 
So that I can quickly find jobs that match my skills, module preference, or schedule.
Acceptance Criteria:
1. User can enter keywords to search jobs 
2. User can filter by module, type of activity, or required skills 
3. Filtered/search results are displayed instantly
Notes: 1. On text/CSV/JSON data files only, no database required. 2. Display results instantly; show 'No matching jobs found' if no matches. 3.Supports multi-condition filtering: module, activity type, and skills. 4.Can integrate with AI skill matching later, but not required for this iteration.

Description:
As a TA applicant
I want to view detailed information about a job
So that I can understand the requirements before applying.
Acceptance Criteria:
1. User can click a job from the job list
2. System displays job details including module name, description, and requirements
3. User can return to the job list page
Notes: Job details include module name, description, activity type, and required skills.

Description:
As a TA applicant
I want to sort job listings
So that I can quickly find the most relevant opportunities.
Acceptance Criteria:
1. User can sort jobs by module name
2. User can sort jobs by posting date
3. Job list updates after sorting
Notes: Sorting is implemented based on job data stored in text/CSV/JSON files.

Description:
As a TA applicant
I want to save jobs as favorites
So that I can review them later easily.
Acceptance Criteria:
1. User can click "Save" on a job
2. Saved jobs are stored (JSON is OK)
3. User can view a list of saved jobs
4. User can remove a saved job

Description:
As a TA applicant
I want to see recently viewed jobs
So that I can easily revisit them.
Acceptance Criteria:
1. System stores recently viewed jobs
2. User can view list of recent jobs
3. List is limited (e.g., last 5 jobs)

Description:
As a TA applicant
I want to apply for a job
So that I can be considered for the position.
Acceptance Criteria:
1. Applicant can submit application
2. Application record is stored
3. Confirmation message is displayed

Description:
As a TA applicant
I want to check my application status
So that I know whether I am selected.
Acceptance Criteria:
1. Applicant can see application status
2. Status includes pending, accepted, rejected
3. Status updates when MO makes decision

Description:
As a TA applicant
I want to view a list of positions I have applied for and adjust their priority order
So that I can inform the MO which positions I prefer to be assigned to first.
Acceptance Criteria:
1. View List: User can view a list of all submitted TA applications
2. Status Display: Each entry must show the position name and current status
3. Reorder: User can change the preference order of applications
Notes: Essential for the algorithm to resolve multiple offers

Description:
As a TA applicant
I want the system to identify missing skills
So that I can improve my qualifications.
Acceptance Criteria:
1. System compares CV with job requirements
2. Missing skills are highlighted
3. Suggestions are displayed

Description:
As a TA applicant
I want the system to recommend suitable TA jobs
So that I can quickly find positions that match my skills.
Acceptance Criteria:
1. System analyses applicant profile and CV
2. System recommends relevant TA jobs
3. Recommended jobs are displayed on the dashboard

Description:
As a MO
I want to post a new TA vacancy 
so that students can apply for the position
Acceptance Criteria:
1. MO can enter module name.
2. MO can enter job title (e.g., TA, Tutor).
3. MO can provide job description (e.g., responsibilities, tasks).
4. MO can define required skills for the position (e.g., communication skills, technical knowledge).
5. MO can specify the application deadline.
6. MO can choose workload (e.g., weekly hours or tasks).
7. MO can click Save to save the vacancy as a draft.
8. MO can click Publish to make the vacancy visible to students.

Description:
As a MO
I want to select a suitable TA from the applicants 
so that I can assign them to the position.
Acceptance Criteria:
1. MO can view the detailed profiles of applicants.
2. MO can see skills, experience, and availability for each applicant.
3. MO can select one applicant and mark them as selected.
4. MO can reject applicants if not selected.
5. MO can update the application status to "Selected" or "Rejected".
6. MO can notify the selected applicant via email or in the system (if email integration is available).MO can view the detailed profiles of applicants.
7. MO can see skills, experience, and availability for each applicant.
8. MO can select one applicant and mark them as selected.
9. MO can reject applicants if not selected.
10. MO can update the application status to "Selected" or "Rejected".
11. MO can notify the selected applicant via email or in the system (if email integration is available).

Description:
As an MO
I want to view a list of applicants who have applied for the TA vacancy 
so that I can review and compare their qualifications
Acceptance Criteria:
1. MO can view a list of all applicants for each vacancy.
2. Each applicant's name and profile summary (e.g., qualifications, skills) are displayed.
3. MO can see application status (e.g., Pending, Shortlisted, Rejected).
4. MO can filter applicants by criteria like skills or status.
5. MO can click on an applicant's name to view the full profile.MO can view a list of all applicants for each vacancy.
6. Each applicant's name and profile summary (e.g., qualifications, skills) are displayed.
7. MO can see application status (e.g., Pending, Shortlisted, Rejected).
8. MO can filter applicants by criteria like skills or status.
9. MO can click on an applicant's name to view the full profile.

Description:
As an MO
I want the system to suggest potential applicants based on their skills 
so that I can quickly identify suitable candidates for the position.
Acceptance Criteria:
1. The system compares job requirements (e.g., skills, experience) with applicant profiles.
2. A matching score or label (e.g., High, Medium, Low) is displayed next to each applicant.
3. MO can override the system's suggestion and make a final decision manually.
4. MO can click on the matching result to view more detailed reasoning behind the match.

Description:
As an administrator
I want to check TA workload
So that no TA is overloaded.
Acceptance Criteria:
1. Admin can view TA assignments
2. System shows number of assigned jobs
3. Warning displayed if workload exceeds limit

Description:
As an administrator
I want the system to recommend TAs with lower workload
So that tasks can be distributed more fairly.
Acceptance Criteria:
1. System calculates workload of each TA
2. TAs with lower workload are highlighted
3. Recommendations appear when MO assigns jobs

Description:
As an administrator
I want to manage user accounts
So that I can maintain system security and integrity.
Acceptance Criteria:
1. Admin can view list of users
2. Admin can deactivate or delete user accounts
3. Admin can view user roles

Description:
As an administrator
I want to manage job postings
So that inappropriate or outdated jobs can be removed.
Acceptance Criteria:
1. Admin can view all job postings
2. Admin can edit job information
3. Admin can delete job postings

Description:
As an administrator
I want to export recruitment data
So that I can analyze recruitment results externally.
Acceptance Criteria:
1. Admin can export applicant data
2. Admin can export job application records
3. Data can be exported as CSV or Excel file

Description:
As an administrator
I want to force-change TA application status from the status-filtered lists
So that I can correct or override MO decisions when needed.
Acceptance Criteria:
1. On the Pending list, admin can Force accept or Force reject each application.
2. On the Accepted list, admin can Force reject or Force pend.
3. On the Rejected list, admin can Force accept or Force pend.
4. Status updates are persisted the same way as normal workflow.
5. After an action, admin sees feedback on the list page.
